newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso ends down, Central Bank buys dlrs.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso ends down, Central Bank buys dlrs.

text.p: The Philippine peso ended a tad lower on Wednesday at 26.196 from 26.195 as the Central Bank kept buying dollars at 26.195 pesos, traders said.
The Central Bank purchased about $77 million at 26.195 pesos in its bid to temper the peso's rise amidst heavy inflows for portfolio and direct equity investments, they said.
The day's average of 26.194 pesos reflected the strong inflows versus Tuesday's 26.199.
